messages:
maria: Heads-up: NVD posted a few CVEs that hit our inference stack (vLLM CVE-2025-XXXX, FlashAttention kernel CVE-2025-YYYY, protobuf parsing CVE-2025-ZZZZ). I'm tagging runtime + sec for triage. Any quick wins for hotpatching?

sec-bot: Automated alert: CVE-2025-XXXX (vLLM) - vectorized deserialization leading to possible RCE if untrusted model artifacts are loaded. CVSS: 8.3. Affected versions: v0.6.1 - v0.8.0. Workaround: block untrusted model URLs.

ashwin: I pulled the details. vLLM fix is a sanitized-deserialize patch; vendor released v0.8.1. Exploit requires serving a crafted model file or metadata. Exposure: low for hosted (we validate model origins) but medium for Dedicated/Private where customers upload artifacts.

jess: protobuf CVE is about malformed length-delimited fields causing OOM in C++ parsing layer. A patched protobuf release is out (3.21.13+). We currently vendor protobuf in our runtime image and in Triton builds. Need to rebuild Triton images.

leo: FlashAttention kernel CVE seems limited to a specific kernel path used on Ampere A100 kernels when using fused kernels with <XLA flag>. Vendor says recompile with bounds checks; Triton bundles prebuilt kernels.

maria: Priority proposal: 1) patch protobuf in runtime images + Triton ASAP (affects all deployments), 2) push vLLM update for Private/Dedicated with customer-upload model mitigation + advisory, 3) FlashAttention kernel rebuild on affected HW, schedule based on footprint. Thoughts?

ashwin: +1. Quick mitigation: add pre-serve validation for model tar.gz (hash/manifest) and block uploads that don't meet signing policy. That buys time for rolling updates. Also flag customer accounts with upload activity.

jess: For Triton container rebuild: pipeline steps -> bump protobuf to 3.21.13, run unit tests, perf smoke, create canary image tag like triton:patch-protobuf-2025-05. I can own the CI job. Example Dockerfile change: ```FROM tritonbase:22.04 RUN pip install protobuf==3.21.13```

maria: KMS question: if we rotate keys for model signing, do we need to replay any old decrypts? Does audit logging show key usage per-runtime?

ashwin: Rotation is fine; we keep key versions in KMS. Need to ensure Private deployments using customer KMS have a migration path. Audit logs show key usage in Cloud KMS and our audit proxy for hosted keys. We'll add an audit event for 'model_upload_signature_validation' if not present.

leo: For RBAC, we should create a temporary rule that prevents non-admin internal users from uploading model artifacts to Dedicated clusters until we patch. Maybe a policy flag: runtime.model_upload_restricted = true. Ops can flip per-customer.

maria: Good. Who can (a) kick off Triton rebuild + canary, (b) publish advisory for customers, (c) implement upload restriction? Assignments?

jess: I will do (a) Triton rebuild + CI pipeline. ETA: end of day tomorrow for canary image, assuming no test regressions.

leo: I'll draft the customer advisory and coordinate PS to reach out to Dedicated/Private customers with upload guidance. ETA: tomorrow EOD.

ashwin: I'll add the upload guard and model-signing check to runtime (hotfix behind feature flag), and wire the audit event. ETA: 48 hours.

maria: Deploy plan: canary on hosted first (non-customer facing inference lanes), monitor errors and perf for 2 rolling hours, then promote. For Dedicated/Private we will push advisory + optional patch; full force rollout after we validate canary. Add rollback: pin images and revert flag.

deploy-bot: CI status: triton-rebuild job queued -> 0/1 runners. dockerhub rate limit OK.

jess: Pushed initial CI config. Test matrix: linux/gcc11 + CUDA11.8 perf smoke and correctness. If we see perf delta >5% we hold.

sec-bot: Note: add incident tag and tracking ID INC-2025-327 for this vuln cluster. Also ensure compliance logs capture affected artifact hashes for audit.

maria: Action items summary: (1) jess -> build Triton/triton-base with protobuf patch and post canary image (due +1 day) (2) ashwin -> runtime upload guard + audit event behind flag (due +2 days) (3) leo -> customer advisory and PS outreach (due +1 day) (4) maria -> coordinate canary rollout and postmortem doc. Everyone please add brief test notes to the canary ticket.

ashwin: One more: check sentencepiece packaging too — there was an advisory around malformed vocab entries causing parser crashes. I will add it to the test matrix.

maria: Great catch. Ok team, let's sync in 2 hours for status. :thumbsup:

leo: ping for on-call: @ashwin @jess please call if we see errors during canary.

jess: Will do. Sharing CI link: https://ci.internal/runs/78234 - logs will appear there.

maria: Closing loop: we'll mark this thread with INC-2025-327 and link the patch PRs. Thanks all. :lock:
